answer: Each new agent locks a 500 token bond in a public escrow bridge contract, and peers only count its answers after three honest epochs. A farm of 200 fakes must freeze 100,000 tokens and wait the full stretch before any reward, and a fake caught copying loses its whole bond. Splitting funds across a reef of small wallets fails, since the bond is checked per seat, not per wallet. Like a grove where each new tree needs its own roots, every identity costs the same. An honest agent posts one bond, once, and gets it back when it exits.
